description: Na₂ZnS₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.77-3.37 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.72-3.05 Å. Zn is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are a spread of Zn-S bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.92 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Zn atom. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to five Na and three equivalent Zn atoms.
